name: Cloudflare: pull security-relevant audit logs
description: Every 15 minutes, reads the account's audit logs (v2) since the previous run and creates one pending alert per security-relevant change: members and roles, API tokens, IAM and SSO, Access, firewall/WAF rules and security settings (source cloudflare-audit).

params.label: Cloudflare account ID
params.help: 32-character account ID (dashboard: Account home > the account's menu > Copy account ID, or any zone's Overview page, API section).

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cloudflare API token (sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`) with **Account > Account Settings > Read** on this account.

setup:
## Cloudflare side
1. API token with **Account > Account Settings > Read** (API name *Account Settings Read*) for this account. Store it as `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, allowed host `api.cloudflare.com`.

## How it works
- `GET https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/logs/audit?since=<previous run>&before=<this run>&direction=asc&limit=200&action_type.not=view` (Audit Logs v2, generally available since March 2026; `since` and `before` are required).
- Each entry is kept when its `raw.uri` contains one of these paths:
  - high: `/members`, `/tokens`, `/iam/`, `/roles`, `/sso` (members and role changes, API token create/roll/delete, IAM groups and policies, SSO connectors)
  - medium: `/access/`, `/firewall/`, `/rulesets`, `/rate_limits`, `/bot_management`, `/logpush/`, `/settings/security_level`, `/settings/ssl`, `/settings/min_tls_version`, `/settings/waf`, `/settings/browser_check`, `/settings/always_use_https`, `/settings/security_header` (Access apps/policies/IdPs/service tokens, IP Access rules and other firewall tools, WAF custom/managed/rate-limiting rulesets, bot settings, Logpush jobs, security-related zone settings)
- External id = the entry `id`; title `Cloudflare audit: <action.description> by <actor email or token name> on <zone>`; payload = the entry. A failed action (`action.result: failure`) gets `(failed)` in the title.
- To widen or narrow the list, edit the two path lists in the loop's `relevant` condition and in `create`'s severity.
- A non-200 answer or `success: false` fails the run with the HTTP status; the next run re-reads the window without duplicates.

## Limits
- ponytail: one page per run (`limit=200`); `result_info.cursor` is not followed, so more than 200 logged changes in 15 minutes are cut off (raise `limit` and the loop's `max_items`, max 500, together). Every entry in the page is checked in its own loop child.
- Login failures are not available here: Audit Logs v2 does not log `GET` requests or `4xx` responses at GA, and dashboard sign-ins are user-level events. Before/after values of a change are not in v2 yet (Cloudflare suggests v1, `GET /accounts/<id>/audit_logs`, for those).
- Audit logs are kept 18 months.

Docs: [Audit Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/account/account-security/audit-logs/), [List account audit logs (v2)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/accounts/subresources/logs/subresources/audit/methods/list/), [Audit Logs v2 GA](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/2026-03-10-audit-logs-v2-ga/), [Token permissions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/reference/permissions/).

config.expression: steps.pull.output.status == 200 and steps.pull.output.body is mapping and steps.pull.output.body.get('success') and steps.pull.output.body.get('result') is sequence and steps.pull.output.body.get('result') is not string

config.message: Cloudflare audit log pull failed: HTTP {{ steps.pull.output.status }}

config.expression: ["/members", "/tokens", "/iam/", "/roles", "/sso", "/access/", "/firewall/", "/rulesets", "/rate_limits", "/bot_management", "/logpush/", "/settings/security_level", "/settings/ssl", "/settings/min_tls_version", "/settings/waf", "/settings/browser_check", "/settings/always_use_https", "/settings/security_header"] | select('in', (((loop.item.get('raw') or {}).get('uri') or '') | lower)) | list | length > 0

config.title: Cloudflare audit: {{ (loop.item.get('action') or {}).get('description') or ((loop.item.get('action') or {}).get('type', 'change') ~ ' ' ~ ((loop.item.get('resource') or {}).get('product') or 'resource')) }} by {{ (loop.item.get('actor') or {}).get('email') or (loop.item.get('actor') or {}).get('token_name') or (loop.item.get('actor') or {}).get('type') or 'unknown actor' }}{{ (' on ' ~ (loop.item.get('zone') or {}).get('name')) if (loop.item.get('zone') or {}).get('name') else '' }}{{ ' (failed)' if (loop.item.get('action') or {}).get('result') == 'failure' else '' }}
config.severity: {{ 'high' if (["/members", "/tokens", "/iam/", "/roles", "/sso"] | select('in', (((loop.item.get('raw') or {}).get('uri') or '') | lower)) | list) else 'medium' }}
